csv_scope_of_work: Professional Engineering consultants services for improvements to County Line Road in West Park, Florida. Project include designs for various segments of County Line Road (NE 215th Street) to include roadway widening, milling and resurfacing, drainage upgrades, concrete curb, sidewalk/ADA compliance, signing and pavement markings, and minor landscaping as directed by the City of West Park. Segments for improvement vary and may range from 800 LF to 0.5 miles. The intent of the improvements is to enhance level of service and provide a resilient and safer roadway for residents and visitors.
